headline: Paperclip Turns AI Agents Into Teams
lede: Paperclip gives autonomous agents an organization chart, budgets, permissions, and persistent state. Its Node.js server and React control plane turn scattered model sessions into an auditable operating system for machine-run work.

headline: Hindsight Gives Agents A Longer Memory
lede: Hindsight builds memory around retain, recall, and reflect cycles rather than a static document store. Its SDKs and deployment options connect long-lived agent context across local installations, Kubernetes, and more than 100 model providers.

headline: ModelOpt Compresses Models For Faster Inference
lede: NVIDIA Model Optimizer brings quantization, pruning, distillation, and architecture search into one composable toolkit. The resulting checkpoints target TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, and SGLang, with latency, memory, and throughput as the governing metrics.

headline: Univer Rebuilds The Office Suite As A Toolkit
lede: Univer makes spreadsheets, documents, and presentations embeddable rather than fixed destinations. Its Canvas renderer, plugin architecture, and shared browser-to-Node API give developers a visual surface they can reshape for SaaS and AI-native workflows.

headline: TensorFlow Keeps The Machine Learning Stack Moving
lede: TensorFlow remains a full-span framework for creating, training, and deploying models across CPUs, GPUs, and edge devices. Its stable APIs, deployment tooling, visualization ecosystem, and enormous community keep the platform in active circulation.

headline: A 523-Lesson Route Into AI Engineering
lede: AI Engineering From Scratch lays out 20 phases, moving from linear algebra and neural networks to agents and MCP. The curriculum insists on derivations, raw implementations, and verifiable artifacts across Python, TypeScript, Rust, and Julia.

headline: OpenBao Puts Credentials Behind A Short Lease
lede: OpenBao stores secrets under encryption and issues temporary credentials that expire when their leases do. Its Go-based platform gives operators centralized access control, renewal, rotation, and revocation without surrendering governance to a closed service.

headline: Buzz Joins Chat, Git, And Agents In One Workspace
lede: Buzz represents messages, reviews, workflows, and repository events as signed, searchable records on a Nostr-compatible relay. Tauri, React, and a JSON-first CLI let teams give humans and scoped agents a shared, auditable place to work.

headline: VS Code Keeps The Edit Loop Extensible
lede: Visual Studio Code binds editing, navigation, debugging, source control, and tooling into a cross-platform workbench. Its extension model lets the same lightweight core adapt to languages, containers, cloud environments, and specialized development habits.

headline: Reverse Skill Makes AI Security Work Methodical
lede: Reverse Skill routes agents toward the right tools for binary analysis, APK inspection, web testing, and deobfuscation. Its rules require scope analysis and tool verification first, replacing guessed commands with repeatable, evidence-based procedures.
